app.name: College Helper
app.description: A study companion for Saudi university students.
app.colophon: College Helper · An answer booklet for Saudi university students

login.title: Open your booklet
login.description: Log in to pick up your questions where you left off.
login.caption: Your details

notes.one: Use the email and password you created your booklet with.
notes.two: Forgot your password? Use the reset link in the form.

signUp.title: A new booklet
signUp.description: Write your university and major on the cover. Every answer after that is written for your program.
signUp.successBody: We sent a confirmation link. Confirm your address, then log in.
signUp.caption: Student details

notes.one: Choose your university, major and study level.
notes.two: Ask about your courses, assignments, research and projects.
notes.three: Every answer is written for your major, and the margin shows what the assistant did.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.

update.title: Choose a new password
update.description: Enter a new password for your account.

authError.title: That link did not work
authError.body: The link may have expired or already been used. Request a new one and try again.

errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.majorMismatch: That major is not offered by the chosen university.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Try logging in.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too easy to guess. Choose a stronger one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.profileInvalid: We couldn't save your study details (university, major and level). Check them and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first using the link we sent, then log in.

instructions.one: Write your question on the last line, then press Ask.
instructions.two: The answer is written below it, and the assistant's marks appear in the red margin.
instructions.three: You can stop the writing at any time from the answer's margin.

default.one: Explain the core ideas I should master first in {major}.
default.two: Help me build a weekly study plan for my {major} courses.
default.three: How do I start a research project in {major}?

prep.one: Help me prepare for my prep-year math and English exams.
prep.two: Explain the key {major} terms in Arabic with their English equivalents.
prep.three: Review a paragraph I wrote in English and correct it.

early.one: Explain the core ideas I should master first in {major}.
early.two: Quiz me with short questions on the last topic I studied.
early.three: Help me make a weekly study plan for my {major} courses.

upper.one: Summarize a {major} paper for me and mark what needs a citation.
upper.two: Give me review questions in the style of past exams.
upper.three: How do I cite my sources in a {major} report?

final.one: Help me scope my graduation project in {major}.
final.three: How should I structure my co-op training report?

postgrad.one: Review the structure of the argument in a chapter of my thesis.
postgrad.two: Help me build a database search strategy for a {major} topic.
postgrad.three: How do I disclose my use of AI in my thesis?

chat.hint: <kbd>Enter</kbd> to ask, <kbd>Shift+Enter</kbd> for a new line
chat.unavailable: The assistant isn't available right now because the service isn't set up yet, so no answer was written. Try again later.
chat.error: The answer didn't arrive. Your question is kept here, and you can try again.
chat.noMatch: No matching course was found in your curriculum.
chat.searchFailed: The curriculum search didn't work this time.
